about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan at (2,2) with a folder of DrkSonic E in both games, BN5's chip 198 by BN5's own code and the registry's 220 by the same code moved (BN5's support routine 0x1B as BN6's 0x45; a DarkChip of the registry's, dealt straight into the battle deck, as its rule (S7) is to come), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/MULTIROM.md, The chips' code).
